cases.name: Katie Samantha Baunach
cases.about: She was a nurse. Annie Moore, Katie's cousin from Louisville, said Katie's life revolved around being a mother and was devoted to her two children.
cases.narrative: Law enforcement searched his property and allegedly found a "fragment of a human mandible with an intact tooth in a fresh burn pile and discovered a blue fifty-gallon barrel near the burn pile which reeked of decaying flesh." They discovered more human bone fragments inside the barrel and around the burn pile.
